Name: Bara Anthro  Furry Characters  Supplement to pornographic content.
Author: XT2048
Description:
[i][b]I painted this mod naked a long time ago. I am always afraid or worried that the author will not give me consent, so I secretly played, but I saw that someone recently uploaded a patch for this mod, so I also uploaded my own copy and obtained authorization.[/b][/i]

[b]The original author is [u]BaraEnthusiast[/u][/b]
[b]His homepage link: https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BaraEnthusiast/about-me?gameId=1303[/b]
[b]Original mod link:[/b] https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22977

The mod is free of charge and is in an updated state. If you have better suggestions, please let me know in the comment section. Due to my busy schedule, I may progress slowly, but don't worry, it won't take long XD

[b][i][u]2024.12[/u][/i][/b]
I will update the walking diagram while refining some portraits. Because I found that some portraits are outdated or do not match the character's walking diagram.
Someone has already created a corresponding collection of bara mods
The original author is [u]Sparkplus[/u]
Original mod link: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30064]Bara Anthro Character Supplement at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community
[/url][i]（I am truly grateful to him because it saved me a lot of effort.）[/i]
The walking diagram and portrait in this game were not initially the same.
There are actually many portrait authors, but the initial author was [b]Entifrisky[/b], and I helped him update some portraits.
[b]His homepage link: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24846]Enti 的 Furry Barafications 在 Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods 和社区[/url][/b]
[b]Of course, please also support the original author.[/b]
[b](and other authors who updated for this, even if your name is not written, thank you very much)[/b]

[i][u]2025.4.4[/u][/i]
I'm really sorry for the delay in updating because I've been extremely busy lately.  However, I have been working on updates, and this time I've uploaded all the textures I've finished drawing at once.  Although some remaining textures, like the particle textures, aren't finished yet, I'll add them later, so please don't worry.  I've already obtained authorization from the new author, so there will be other versions coming up.  Please look forward to them.
[b]2025.10.16
I've already found someone to teach me programming. Now you can directly install these mods. Let's celebrate! 🎉（Special thanks to Papalacha and you.）[/b]
